en: Black‑and‑white view of a European cobblestone street lined with 3–4‑story masonry buildings. On the left are older plastered houses with shuttered windows and arched doorways, one bearing a hanging sign; next to them is a long, monumental stone building with repetitive arched windows and a heavy cornice, resembling a public or institutional facility. People in early 20th‑century dress walk along the sidewalk and a few figures stand further down the street; gas‑style street lamps are visible.
